landing.title.description: Heading and document title of the landing page that people who are not signed in see at the root address. {instance} is the name of this server.

landing.sign_in.description: Button on the landing page that opens the server's sign-in screen.

landing.sign_up.open.description: Link on the landing page to the server's registration page, when anyone may sign up.

landing.sign_up.approval.description: Link on the landing page to the server's registration page, when moderators approve each sign-up.

landing.sign_up.invite.defaultMessage: Create an account with an invite
landing.sign_up.invite.description: Link on the landing page to the server's registration page, when only people with an invite may sign up.

landing.registrations.approval.defaultMessage: Moderators review each new account before it can be used.
landing.registrations.approval.description: Note next to the landing page's registration link, when moderators approve each sign-up.

landing.registrations.invite.defaultMessage: Only people with an invite can create an account.
landing.registrations.invite.description: Note next to the landing page's registration link, when only people with an invite may sign up.

landing.registrations.closed.defaultMessage: This server is not accepting new accounts.
landing.registrations.closed.description: Text on the landing page, in place of the registration link, when nobody may sign up.

landing.about.title.description: Heading of the landing page's section with the server's description.

landing.rules.title.description: Heading of the landing page's section with the server's rules.

landing.posts.title.description: Heading of the landing page's section with a few recent public posts of this server's accounts.

landing.posts.more.description: Link under the recent posts of the landing page to the local timeline.

landing.posts.failed.description: Heading shown in place of the recent posts of the landing page when they could not be loaded.

landing.posts.empty.description: Heading shown in place of the recent posts of the landing page when there are none.

landing.hero.eyebrow.description: Small line above the landing page's heading; uppercase Latin letters in both languages (the product's name is not translated).

landing.features.title.defaultMessage: What you can do with my
landing.features.title.description: Heading of the landing page's section with three cards about the software's features.

landing.features.federation.title.description: Title of the landing page's card about federation.

landing.features.federation.body.defaultMessage: Follow and talk with people on Mastodon, Misskey and other servers that speak ActivityPub.
landing.features.federation.body.description: Text of the landing page's card about federation.

landing.features.emoji.title.description: Title of the landing page's card about custom emoji and reactions.

landing.features.emoji.body.defaultMessage: React to posts with custom emoji, including those from other servers.
landing.features.emoji.body.description: Text of the landing page's card about custom emoji and reactions.

landing.features.language.title.description: Title of the landing page's card about languages.

landing.features.language.body.defaultMessage: Use the app in English or Japanese, and tag each post with its language.
landing.features.language.body.description: Text of the landing page's card about languages.
